我们需要招募一名总督来管理我们新的£colony£殖民地。要进行招募，可点击殖民地，进入到殖民地总览标签中，在总督窗口点击更换按钮。此时会展开一个领袖窗口，显示现在为我们工作的总督。

在屏幕上方点击招募按钮，选择一名可供使用的总督。注意，招募领袖会花费£unity£凝聚力。如果储备不足，就要等到收集足够后再进行招募。

新总督招募完毕后将会在母星等待安排。

texts.en:
We should recruit a Governor to administer our new £colony£ Colony. To do this, click on the colony and go into its Colony Summary tab. Then click on the Change button in the Governor window. This will open the Leaders screen, showing the Governors currently working for us.

Click on the Recruit button in the upper portion of the screen, and select from among the available candidates. Note that Leaders always cost £unity £Unity to recruit. If we lack the needed amount, we will have to wait until enough has been generated to afford the leader.

Once recruited, the new Governor will be awaiting assignment on our homeworld.
